description: Query Dynatrace metrics via the v2 Metrics API → DataFrame. Returns per-series rows with timestamps + dimensions.

api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the API token (metrics.read scope)
api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var

resolution.description: Resolution: '1m', '5m', '1h', etc. Coarser resolutions cover longer time-frames.
resolution.label: Resolution

timeframe.description: Time range: relative (now-Nh / now-Nd) or absolute ISO 8601 (start_iso/end_iso) On a partitioned run {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} (and {partition_<dimension>} for multi-partitions) are substituted.
timeframe.label: Timeframe

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values
